requirements.req: Remove/repair a bathtub wastewater overflow trip lever that is stuck in the hidden plumbing behind the tub wall; restore reliable drain stopper operation (trip lever actuates a drop cylinder/plunger in the overflow tee).
requirements.status: Owner-supplied problem statement; mechanism per manufacturer doc

requirements.req: First attempt service from above/inside the tub through the overflow opening (overflow plate, linkage and drop-cylinder removal/readjustment is the manufacturer-documented service path). Do not force parts in a way that damages the hidden tee/elbow.
requirements.status: Verified as manufacturer service path for plate/linkage/cylinder only (RULE-07)

requirements.req: If from-above removal fails, access from below through the ceiling of the unit/storage space below: open drywall ceiling, expose tee/overflow elbow, replace/repair, then patch, tape, texture and paint-match the ceiling.
requirements.status: Owner requirement; trade scopes per CSLB (B/C-9 for ceiling, C-36 for plumbing)

requirements.req: Single point of responsibility for plumbing + drywall opening + patch/finish (one B+C-36 licence, or a B/B-2 prime subcontracting the other trade to an appropriately licensed contractor). No separate owner-coordinated drywall hire if avoidable.
requirements.status: Licensing structure verified (BPC 7057(b)); no firm has yet agreed to this scope — blank/unconfirmed

requirements.req: Plumbing performed under a current/active CSLB C-36 (or B holding C-36). Re-check the exact licence number on CSLB on the day of contracting.
Confirm in writing who physically performs the work and whose workers'-comp covers them, especially for WC-exempt (no-employees) licences.

Contractor to determine permit applicability under SF Plumbing Code §104.2 and, where a permit is required, obtain it as a City-registered contractor (PermitSF/Express Permit where eligible) and pass inspection before covering pipes.

Work in an occupied unit: written tenant notice with date, approximate time and purpose (24h presumed reasonable), entry during normal business hours unless tenant consents otherwise, dust/water protection, same-day water restoration plan, and protection of the unit below before any ceiling opening.

Written itemised quote before work: from-above attempt price, below-access price, ceiling patch/finish line item, parts (waste-and-overflow kit), permit/inspection fees if any, and not-to-exceed terms. Existing owner estimates are unverified and must be re-quoted.
requirements.status: Flagged F-01/F-02; fee schedule is linked from the SF.gov permit page

requirements.req: Prefer a firm that can point to prior waste-and-overflow / in-wall tub plumbing work in San Francisco (owner to read current reviews on the linked Yelp search and ask for references). Review-platform figures are snapshots, never verified facts.
requirements.status: Flagged F-03/F-07 — no job-specific confirmation exists yet

requirements.req: Before/after photos, old parts retained for owner inspection, and a written note of what was found in the tee/overflow (the owner photos referenced in the brief are not in this repo — F-09).
Provider must serve the San Francisco address of the unit (all licences in providers.json list San Francisco addresses on their CSLB records).
